thread:
alex: Powell underpass is basically a shallow lake right now. Anyone rerouting or taking shuttle? :sweat_smile:
maria: Yep — 24 bus detoured around Powell, added ~18 mins to my commute. Definitely bring shoes you don’t care about. :umbrella:
samir: @alex same. Took the 5th St detour. Ubers are surge-y here, FYI.
jo: Walked around it via the hill. Shoes soaked, but beat the bus delay. If you’re nearby I have extra socks in my desk (2F). :socks: 
dana: I left a box of donuts in the 3rd-floor kitchenette for anyone making the soggy commute. Fuel for the brave. :donut:
alex: blessing. :pray: @dana you are a hero.
maria: Quick poll — who’s taking the company shuttle this morning vs switching to BART/Caltrain/scooter? React with :one: shuttle, :two: BART, :three: scooter/walk
samir: :three: scooter — faster for short hops if you can keep dry. But slippery.
transit-bot: Shuttle 07:30 from HQ running 10-15 min delay due to reroute around Powell underpass (service advisory). https://status.example.com/shuttle (ETA updates every 5m)
jo: Also FYI — MUNI app showing a temporary stop change, screenshot attached in thread.
(This is a short manual snippet people posted — image link: https://img.example/soggy-stop.jpg)
maria: Pro tip: if you’re near Market & 3rd, the coffee shop on the corner is handing out free coffee to soaking commuters. :coffee:
samir: If anyone needs a ride from the 3rd floor to the ferry, I’m heading that way in 10. DM me.
dana: Also — FYI to folks working remote today, parking garage entrance at Powell is closed so deliveries are being rerouted to 4th Ave. Heads up for package folks.
alex: Thanks everyone. If you’re stuck and need A) socks B) donut C) a ride, reply here and we’ll coordinate. :thumbsup:
jo: A: claimed socks, B: donuts, C: maybe later if rain dies down. :sweat_smile:
transit-bot: Update 08:03 — Water level decreasing, crews on-site. Expect partial reopening in 30-45m. Stay safe.
maria: Good to hear. See you all (eventually) — and thanks @dana for the donut morale boost.
samir: +1 morale. :doughnut: End of soggy commute thread.
